mapper.sql: select id, create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, serial_number, specification, material, measure_unit, accounting_unit, quantity, mete, unit_price, length, total_length, plate, total_area, total_amount, weight, total_weight, main_id from project_return_product_child
mapper.select:
SELECT mbwr.id AS 'id', mbwr.product_type as 'productType', mbwr.warehouse_record_id AS 'mesBuildingWarehouseRecordId', te.project_id AS 'projectId', te.monomer_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, te.area_id, pa.name area_name, ep.id AS 'planId', ep.NAME AS 'planName', te.NAME AS 'productName', te.serial_number AS 'serialNumber', TRIM( LEADING '/' FROM TRIM( BOTH '/' FROM CONCAT_WS( '/', COALESCE(te.thickness, ''), COALESCE(te.color, ''), COALESCE(te.material, '') ) ) ) AS specification, te.id AS 'productId', mbwr.quantity AS 'quantity', te.plate AS 'plate', ROUND(mbwr.length / 1000, 6) as 'length', (mbwr.length * mbwr.quantity) AS 'totalLength', ROUND(mbwr.surface_area, 6) as 'surfaceArea', (mbwr.surface_area*mbwr.quantity) AS 'totalArea' FROM mes_building_cargo_list cargo INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list_product_link mbwr ON mbwr.cargo_list_id = cargo.id LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure te ON mbwr.product_id = te.id AND te.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm on te.monomer_id = pm.id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa on te.area_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan ep ON te.enclosure_plan_id = ep.id WHERE mbwr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbwr.product_type = 4 AND mbwr.warehouse_type in (0, 2) AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.status in(4, 8)
and te.project_id = #{projectId}
and te.enclosure_plan_id = #{planId}
and te.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and te.serial_number like concat('%', #{serialNumber}, '%')
and te.material like concat('%', #{material}, '%')
ORDER BY mbwr.id DESC

SELECT mbwr.id AS 'id', mbwr.product_type as 'productType', mbwr.warehouse_record_id AS 'mesBuildingWarehouseRecordId', tsp.project_id AS 'projectId', tsp.NAME AS 'productName', tsp.id AS 'productId', ROUND(tsp.mete * mbwr.quantity / tsp.quantity, 2) AS mete, ROUND(tsp.mete / tsp.quantity, 2) AS single_mete, ep.id AS 'planId', ep.NAME AS 'planName', tsp.specification AS 'specification', mbwr.quantity AS 'quantity', tsp.measure_unit AS 'measureUnit', tsp.accounting_unit AS 'accountingUnit' FROM mes_building_cargo_list cargo INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list_product_link mbwr ON mbwr.cargo_list_id = cargo.id INNER JOIN tech_standard_part tsp ON mbwr.product_id = tsp.id AND tsp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan ep ON ep.id = tsp.enclosure_plan_id AND ep.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbwr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND tsp.relation_type = 4 AND mbwr.product_type = 8 AND mbwr.warehouse_type in (0, 2) AND (cargo.status = 4 OR cargo.status = 8)
and tsp.project_id = #{projectId}
and tsp.enclosure_plan_id = #{planId}
and tsp.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and tsp.serial_number like concat('%', #{serialNumber}, '%')
and tsp.specification like concat('%', #{specification}, '%')
and tsp.material like concat('%', #{material}, '%')
ORDER BY mbwr.id DESC

SELECT prpc.id AS 'id', prpc.factory_id AS 'factoryId', prpc.project_id AS 'projectId', prpc.product_type as 'productType', prpc.monomer_id AS 'monomerId', prpc.area_id AS 'areaId', prpc.product_name AS 'productName', prpc.measure_unit AS 'measureUnit', prpc.unit_price AS 'unitPrice', prpc.total_area AS 'totalArea', prpc.main_id AS 'mainId', prpc.plate AS 'plate', monomer.name as monomerName, area.name as areaName, prpc.plan_name as planName, prpc.number AS 'number', prpc.product_id AS 'productId', prpc.specification AS 'specification', prpc.serial_number AS 'serialNumber', prpc.quantity AS 'quantity', prpc.total_length AS 'totalLength', prpc.length AS 'length', NULLIF(prpc.quantity * prpc.net_weight,0) AS 'totalNetWeight', prpc.net_weight AS 'netWeight', prpc.accounting_unit AS 'accountingUnit', prpc.pricing_manner AS 'pricingManner', prpc.mete AS 'mete', prpc.surface_area AS 'surfaceArea', prpc.material AS 'material', prpc.total_amount AS 'totalAmount', prpc.unit_price AS 'unitPrice', prpc.plate AS 'plate', prpc.measure_unit AS 'measureUnit' FROM project_return_product_child prpc LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer ON prpc.monomer_id = monomer.id AND monomer.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON prpc.area_id = area.id AND area.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE prpc.main_id = #{id}

SELECT prpc.id AS 'id', prpc.factory_id AS 'factoryId', prpc.id AS 'mesBuildingReturnWarehouseRecordId', prpc.create_time AS 'createTime', prpc.project_id AS 'projectId', cp.name as projectName, prpc.product_reason as 'productReason', prpc.product_type as 'productType', prpc.monomer_id AS 'monomerId', prpc.area_id AS 'areaId', prpc.product_name AS 'productName', prpc.measure_unit AS 'measureUnit', prpc.unit_price AS 'unitPrice', prpc.total_area AS 'totalArea', prpc.main_id AS 'mainId', prpm.storage_location, prpc.warehouse_id, prpc.warehouse_id 'warehouse.id', wr.name 'warehouse.name', prpc.plate AS 'plate', prpc.plan_name as 'planName', prpc.number AS 'number', prpc.product_id AS 'productId', prpc.specification AS 'specification', prpc.serial_number AS 'serialNumber', prpc.quantity AS 'quantity', prpc.total_length AS 'totalLength', prpc.length AS 'length', prpc.total_net_weight AS 'totalNetWeight', prpc.net_weight AS 'netWeight', prpc.accounting_unit AS 'accountingUnit', prpc.pricing_manner AS 'pricingManner', prpc.mete AS 'mete', prpc.single_mete AS 'singleMete', prpc.surface_area AS 'surfaceArea', prpc.material AS 'material', prpc.total_amount AS 'totalAmount', prpc.unit_price AS 'unitPrice', prpc.plate AS 'plate', prpc.measure_unit AS 'measureUnit' FROM project_return_product_child prpc INNER JOIN project_return_product_main prpm ON prpc.main_id = prpm.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON prpc.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse wr ON prpc.warehouse_id = wr.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact a on prpc.product_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure a on prpc.product_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN tech_standard_part a on prpc.product_id = a.id
WHERE prpc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND prpm.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND prpc.handle_method IN (2, 3) AND prpm.audit_status = 2
AND prpc.project_id = #{projectId}
and prpm.product_type = #{type}
AND a.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND a.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
AND a.material like concat('%',#{material},'%')
AND a.specification like concat('%',#{specification},'%')
AND a.plate like concat('%',#{specification},'%')
AND a.relation_type = #{relationType}
